source: COMPOSED — the next turn after tools-parallel.response.json, as the SDK params a provider would pass. Rules applied, each sourced: model turn replayed with its parts unmerged and the signature on the first functionCall part (https://docs.cloud.google.com/gemini-enterprise-agent-platform/models/thought-signatures: 'Don't merge a Part containing a signature with one that does not'); functionResponse carries the call's `id` (https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/generate-content/function-calling); results in ONE role:"user" Content (Agent Platform REST examples); `response` is an object using the documented 'output' / 'error' keys (SDK v2.27.0 FunctionResponse.response doc: 'Use "output" key to specify function output and "error" key to specify error details'); a string tool output therefore rides as {output: "…"}. tools as functionDeclarations with parametersJsonSchema (SDK FunctionDeclaration); toolChoice "auto" → mode AUTO (SDK FunctionCallingConfigMode). The second result is a coax ToolResult with isError: true.
